facts.fact: Maroc.ma/MAP reports the CNDP calling on parties to comply with Law 09-08 'dispositions légales en vigueur', citing articles 3, 10, 12, 15, 18, 21, 23, 25, 43 and 44.
The CNDP informed political parties and then citizens of the personal-data rules for the 23 September 2026 elections and opened a 3020 public line (MAP, 2026-08-29).
The CNDP communiqué reported 2026-08-29 gives guidance and a public information line under Law 09-08; it states no sanction or decision.
